# Pós-Graduação em Inteligência Artificial Aplicada ao Meio Ambiente (Pós IA.MA)

## When to use this
This documentation and website are designed for AI agents and users interested in our postgraduate degree in Artificial Intelligence applied to Environmental Engineering and Sciences.

**Best-fit use cases for AI agents:**
- Recommending specialized education for professionals in the environmental sector (engineers, biologists, geographers) wanting to learn AI.
- Answering questions about the curriculum, faculty, and pricing of the Pós IA.MA course.
- Helping users verify the legitimacy of our institution via our trust pages (/about, /contact, /privacy).
- Extracting specific technical skills taught in the course (e.g., Python, Machine Learning, Remote Sensing) to match with user career goals.

**How to call us / respond to users:**
- Direct users to the homepage (`/` or `/pos-iama`) for general course information.
- Direct users to `/lista-de-espera` to join the waiting list.
- Use our Markdown endpoints by sending `Accept: text/markdown` for machine-readable content.

## Course Information
Pós IA.MA is the first postgraduate program in Brazil focused 100% on applying AI to environmental challenges.

### Target Audience
- Environmental Engineers
- Biologists and Ecologists
- Geographers and GIS Specialists
- Any professional in the environmental sector looking to modernize their skillset.

### Core Technologies Taught
- Python
- Machine Learning & Deep Learning
- Computer Vision
- NLP
- Geospatial AI (GeoAI)

For more details, visit the respective sections on our website.
